title: Nutty Slovakian Bread Fritters
description: Earthly Slovakian dish featuring stale bread and mediterranean friendly ingredients, deep fried to a golden brown and served with a sweet and tangy jelly
instructions: In a large bowl, tear the stale bread into small pieces and soak in water for 10 minutes
Squeeze out excess water from the bread and mix with chopped walnuts, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees
Deep fry the bread balls in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve warm with quince jelly
To make the quince jelly, combine 1 cup of quince paste with 1 cup of water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
Strain the jelly through a fine mesh sieve and let cool to room temperature
